name: session
description: Session handoff reports and recall helpers for Codex. Writes reports under the project root .harness/sessions directory, shared with the Claude Code session plugin and in the same format, and retrieves prior work from either tool through list, filter, grep, resume and last workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Write and recall agent-agnostic session reports
interface.longDescription: Create structured handoff reports and retrieve previous work through deterministic local scripts. Reports are stored in the project root .harness/sessions directory, shared with the Claude Code session plugin, so a session can be resumed in either tool from the same files and format.
defaultPrompt: Write a session report for this work.
